# Getting help

- **Setting it up:** follow [Setup](../README.md#setup) in the README.
- **Broken icons or a feature disappeared:** go to `chrome://extensions` and click reload ↻ on Alma+, then refresh Alma.
- **Tasks are missing:** don't remove the extension or move its folder. Restore from your backup with **Restore tasks** on the To Do page.
- **Found a bug or have an idea:** open an [issue](https://github.com/ians0316/alma-plus/issues) or see [Report a bug](../README.md#report-a-bug).
